rationale: The first predeclared rematched-candidate variant produces42 no_descent histories, including34 originally converged cases. Test a separately declared continuous inner surrogate: hold all baseline source/target IDs and target shapes fixed, retransport source shapes at each trial. Source-metric gradient, SPD preconditioner, Armijo1e-4, six scales,30 iterations and tolerances stay identical. Rematch at the next outer baseline; no cross-surrogate monotonicity assertion. No result-driven grid/tolerance changes or native adoption yet.
controls: Same numerical/frame/gradient controls required before any native implementation; compare all54 originally converged histories and all10 limited histories. Report regressions and all costs. A lower shape score is not an accuracy result.
